record.synthesis_method: ball milling (LiBH4 and LiCl ball-milled, then P2S5 added and ball-milled); powder pressed into pellets
record.evidence_quote: The calculated Ea for LCPS10 and LCPS20 SSEs are 0.40 (2) eV and 0.49 (2) eV respectively. Overall, a remarkable ionic conductivity of about 10-3 S cm-1 near RT is reached for LCPS10.
record.notes: Value is for the sample after heat treatment at 150 °C (as stated in the paper); the heat treatment is not treated as sintering, so sintering fields are null. Nominal composition 90(3LiBH4·LiCl)·10P2S5 is from the Experimental section. Abstract gives the same ~10-3 value. Material is not a dopant case; LiCl and P2S5 are constituents.

record.synthesis_method: ball milling (LiBH4 and LiCl ball-milled, then P2S5 added and ball-milled); powder pressed into pellets
record.evidence_quote: The two samples show comparable conductivity at RT, in the order of 10-5 S cm-1.
record.notes: Value is only an order of magnitude ('in the order of'), and it is stated for both LCPS10 and LCPS20 together; assigned to LCPS20 as the second sample. Ea 0.49(2) eV for LCPS20 is from a separate sentence in the results. Quote does not name LCPS20 directly; identification is from the sentence context.
